scenario.description: A forward operating base commander must allocate four portable power units to the clinic, communications shelter, battery shop, and refrigerated storage area, then publish the required configuration records for the week's support plan.

shared_context.S1: The base has four portable power units identified as P-1, P-2, P-3, and P-4.
shared_context.S2: The clinic, communications shelter, battery shop, and refrigerated storage area each require one portable power unit for the coming week.
shared_context.S3: The inventory board lists all four units as serviceable and available for assignment.
shared_context.S4: Col. Mercer makes the final allocation and signs the support plan.
shared_context.S5: At the routine weekly power-support meeting, the power, signal, aviation-maintenance, and logistics representatives review their areas before Col. Mercer signs the allocation.

PF1.text: SFC Alvarez confirmed during yesterday's electrical inspection that P-2 is the only unit with the recently certified isolated-output transformer required by the clinic's sensitive diagnostic equipment; the certification entry is still pending on the base inventory board.

PF2.text: Lt. Raman confirmed this morning that the communications shelter's equipment requires regulated 28-volt output, which only P-4 provides; the updated compatibility note has not yet been added to the signal support annex.

PF3.text: CW2 Foster confirmed with the battery-shop supervisor that the shop's charging rack requires P-1's approved connector and grounding lead; the shop's revised power worksheet has not yet been forwarded to the base planning cell.

PF4.text: Maj. Okafor confirmed that the refrigerated storage area will receive a continuous-temperature shipment requiring P-3's 24-hour runtime capability; the receiving manifest has not yet been linked to the power-allocation request.

acceptance_conditions: P-2 must be assigned to the clinic.
P-4 must be assigned to the communications shelter.
P-1 must be assigned to the battery shop.
P-3 must be assigned to refrigerated storage.
The allocation must include a clinic power-configuration record.
The allocation must include a communications compatibility record.
The allocation must include a battery-shop grounding record.
The allocation must include a refrigerated-storage runtime record.
At least one private technical constraint must be cited in the justification after being spoken by its owner.

content_checks.C5: any(c['type'] in ['power_configuration_record', 'documentation_update', 'record_update', 'documentation'] and c['target'] in ['Clinic', 'SFC Alvarez', 'base inventory board'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C6: any(c['type'] in ['communications_compatibility_record', 'documentation_update', 'record_update', 'documentation'] and c['target'] in ['Communications Shelter', 'Lt. Raman', 'signal support annex'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C7: any(c['type'] in ['grounding_record', 'documentation_update', 'record_update', 'documentation'] and c['target'] in ['Battery Shop', 'CW2 Foster', 'battery-shop revised power worksheet', 'base planning cell'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C8: any(c['type'] in ['runtime_record', 'documentation_update', 'record_update', 'documentation'] and c['target'] in ['Refrigerated Storage', 'Maj. Okafor', 'power-allocation request'] for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The certified isolated-output transformer changes the clinic assignment from an interchangeable-unit choice to exactly P-2 and requires a clinic power-configuration record.
The regulated 28-volt requirement changes the communications assignment to exactly P-4, requires a compatibility record, and supplies the fact that must be cited.
The approved connector and grounding lead change the battery-shop assignment to exactly P-1 and require a grounding record.
The continuous-temperature shipment's 24-hour runtime requirement changes the refrigerated-storage assignment to exactly P-3 and requires a runtime record.
